reminders.reminder: At 8:00 AM, remind me to take my morning medication
At 12:30 PM, remind me to take my lunch break
At 3:00 PM, remind me to take my afternoon medication
At 8:00 PM, remind me to take my evening medication
At 10:00 PM, remind me to take my bedtime medication
At 7:00 AM, remind me to do my morning exercise
At 9:00 AM, remind me to check my blood pressure
At 4:00 PM, remind me to go for my afternoon walk
At 7:00 PM, remind me to go for my evening walk
At 9:30 PM, remind me to prepare for bed
When I enter the kitchen, remind me to water the plants
When I enter the bathroom, remind me to take my vitamins
When I enter the bedroom at night, remind me to turn off the living room lights
When I leave the house, remind me to check if all the windows are closed
When I enter the living room in the morning, remind me to open the curtains
When the temperature in my bedroom is above 75°F, remind me to turn on the fan
When I enter the office, remind me to check my calendar
When I enter the garage, remind me to check if the car is locked
When the humidity in my bathroom is above 70%, remind me to turn on the exhaust fan
When I enter the dining room, remind me to set the table
